_note: Informal MCP server discovery manifest. The Server Card WG (https://modelcontextprotocol.io/community/working-groups/server-card.md) has not yet ratified a standard shape for this file. Fields below are self-describing; consumers should treat unknown fields as informational.

server.name: bot-creator
server.description: Read-only access to Bot Creator documentation, blog posts, and site content.

tools.name: search_docs
tools.description: Search Bot Creator function documentation by name, slug, or category.

tools.name: get_doc
tools.description: Fetch raw markdown of a Bot Creator function doc by slug.

tools.name: list_posts
tools.description: List Bot Creator blog posts, optionally filtered by locale (en/fr).

tools.name: search_posts
tools.description: Search Bot Creator blog posts by title or description.

tools.name: get_post
tools.description: Fetch raw markdown of a Bot Creator blog post by slug.
